blocking_issues: The card is close, but several facts are source/process-facing rather than Honcho-ready in-world facts.
One boundary imports broader Magon prophecy context beyond the target record and turns it into an overconfident cultural interpretation.
format_errors: Card facts contain source-facing/source-reference language: `source record`, `attested`, and `what the source directly supports`.
Honcho facts must be in-world card entries with no source refs or draft/process language.
manual_review_notes: The source is thin but sufficient for a useful minor-character card; blocked_source_insufficient should remain false.
missing_opportunities: Keep the card thin and direct: name/title, Patriarch role, day of red light ritual, dominance over rival chiefs, large armored appearance, approximate 30,000-year lifespan, and strict unknowns around personal name, voice, motive, and biography.
revision_instructions: Remove all source-facing phrases from facts; use in-world wording such as `BOUNDARY: No known personal name, direct speech, interior motive, or biography beyond the ritual-combat role and approximate lifespan.`
Replace the overconfident challenge/prophecy language with a narrower fact: `TRAIT: Followers expect the Patriarch to defeat every rival chief on the day of red light.`
Delete or heavily soften the prophecy boundary. If retained at all, keep it outside the Patriarch's personal knowledge unless the bundle directly supports that he knows or accepts it.
Do not add invented biography or importance; this is a valid source-thin minor-character card once the unsupported and source-facing wording is removed.
unsupported_claims: `TRAIT: expected to always win the ritual combat; no successful challenge against this Patriarch is attested in the source record` is not stage-ready: the broader volume context says Aghnar defeats the Magon leader/Patriarch, and the source-record phrasing cannot remain in the card.

`BOUNDARY: Magon lore includes a prophecy that an outside figure will defeat the Patriarch and lead the Magon onward; the culture has a framework for absorbing such a defeat` overstates the prophecy and infers a cultural framework not directly supported by the target source bundle.
